assets.prompt: Create a single Nigerian driving quiz study illustration: an inverted equilateral triangular GIVE WAY road sign, point DOWN. Bold RED triangular border, flat YELLOW interior, with two centred lines of crisp BLACK uppercase text exactly GIVE and WAY. Flat front view, geometric accurate shape, no pole, no scenery, no 3D, no shadows or texture. Single isolated sign occupies 82% of a square white canvas with generous even white margins. This is the Nigerian yellow-background road-sign variant illustrated in FRSC's MI-III Compendium 2025 page 4. No captions, watermarks, logo or extra symbols. Clean raster illustration legible at 140px; not a collage.

Create a single Nigerian driving quiz study illustration of a NO STOPPING road sign. The diagonals join the red border. No letters or numbers anywhere. Exactly two diagonals; this must clearly differ from a one-diagonal no-parking sign. Front view, no pole, no scene, no texture, no shadow, no 3D. Occupy 82% of a square plain white canvas, margins on every side. Geometric crisp high contrast clean raster graphic, legible at 140px. FRSC MI-III Compendium 2025 page 4 depicts this blue red-cross variant. No captions, logo or watermark.
